[h2]How does it work?[/h2] This mod works by adding 637 201 items to the game (don't worry, you shouldn't encounter any of these in a run), each tied to one of the game's achievements, then at the start of a new run it checks it's availability along vanilla unlockables and if it succeeds it marks the associated achievement as unlocked. [h2]Limitations[/h2] The check is only performed on the start of a new run, new floor or when continuing a run from the file menu. May cause TMTrainer items to be more boring (untested) [h2]Developer Info[/h2] Head to the GitHub repository for documentation.
